compatibility_findings: Missing native composition root attributes: data-composition-id, data-width, and data-height.
No paused GSAP timeline is registered at window.__timelines[composition-id].
No scene:<id> timeline labels are declared; data-om-id alone marks pointable regions, not scenes or a seekable composition.
The draft uses CSS keyframes instead of the documented paused, seek-driven GSAP timeline, so deterministic frame seeking is unproven.
The draft does not include vendor/om.js. It hard-codes copy and uses no composition variables; variable declarations apply when editable variables are used.

upstream_shape.runtime_helper: vendor/om.js (written by `om new`; not vendored into this repository)

integration_paths.why: The current HTML draft does not implement the pinned native composition contract; a <=8 s project alone does not make it renderable.
steps: om fork huashu-motion/shots/pNN huashu-motion/shots/pNN-portrait --size 1080x1920 (or author the portrait frame directly)
replace the scaffolded index.html only after implementing the pinned composition root and timeline; first-shot window is 4.0 s
integration_paths.note: Every one of these commands needs the Owner's execution authorization. None has been run.

integration_paths.why: The 21 s CSS-only draft is not a compatible Huashu Motion project; no whole-film render or subsequent cut is prepared.
integration_paths.extra_step: The cut is a local ffmpeg step. Each cut clip is checked again; a clip that fails the gate does not enter M4.5.
integration_paths.cost: One render instead of six, but the cut points are a new place where the timeline can drift.

upstream_commands_verbatim.render: om render [dir] [--format mp4|mov|webm|gif] [--fps 30] [--out file] [--workers n] [--video extract|seek] [--frames jpg|png] [--blur n] [--silent] [--transparent]

expected_outputs.render: one media file per project under <project>/out/
expected_outputs.check: findings; the process exits 1 when any finding is error-level
expected_outputs.qa: a report over the newest render or the given video

verified_contract.composition_root: An HTML composition root declares data-composition-id, data-width, and data-height.
verified_contract.timeline: A paused GSAP timeline is registered in window.__timelines[composition-id].
verified_contract.pointable_regions: data-om-id marks stable visible regions; it does not replace scene labels or timeline registration.
verified_contract.variables: When editable values are used, declare defaults on html[data-composition-variables] and bind them through documented variable APIs; this draft uses fixed copy and declares none.
verified_contract.runtime: om new supplies vendor/om.js; the draft does not currently include that runtime.

requirements_at_render_time.browser: Chrome, Chromium or Edge on this machine
requirements_at_render_time.windows: upstream states it has only been tested on macOS; Windows support is UNVERIFIED

output_notes: a render of 4 s or longer carries an upstream 'Made with huashu-motion' credit line in the last 1.2 s unless the film opts out
`om render --silent` suppresses the missing-soundtrack warning only; ffprobe must verify the output stream list and the derived AudioPolicy file again
a 3.5 s clip is below the 4 s credit-line threshold, but the rule is upstream's and is not waived by this repository
